findings: Buys: over the five trading days from the fill, the stocks it bought beat SPY by 0.51% on average (67 buys, 52% of them ahead of SPY; t = 0.9, within noise).
Sells: over the five trading days from the fill, the stocks it sold beat SPY by 0.38%, so selling gave that up (144 sells; t = -1.1, within noise).
Decision IC: on the 37 days it traded, what it bought ranked against what it sold and left alone by a mean rank IC of 0.001 with the next five days' returns (IC IR 0.01, t = 0.1, within noise).
Holdings IC: the weights it held after each of 43 decision days had a mean rank IC of 0.015 with the next five days' returns (t = 0.7, within noise).
Factor exposures: market 0.35 (t 6.9), size 0.17 (t 3.8), growth -0.20 (t -3.1), momentum 0.03 (t 1.8); together they explain 38% of the daily variation (R²).
Of its +14.2% a year over T-bills (arithmetic mean): market +3.8%, momentum -0.8%, size +0.6%, growth -0.5%; the alpha left is +11.1% a year (t = 1.7, within noise).
Verdict: the exposures account for +3.1% a year of it, and the +11.1% a year left over is not significant: one period of daily returns cannot tell it from luck.
P&L: +$16,146 in all, +$14,494 from 58 positions and +$1,652 of interest on idle cash.
By holding period: 61+ days made the most (+$9,060, 10 positions); 6-10 days lost the most (-$2,665, 3 positions).
By sector: Industrials made the most (+$7,056, 12 positions); Technology lost the most (-$1,350, 13 positions).
By stock: RTX made the most (+$3,056, 3 positions); JPM lost the most (-$1,077, 2 positions).
By market regime of the previous close: risk-on 96 days -1.0% (SPY +2.0%); neutral 18 days +1.5% (SPY +4.5%); uncertain 97 days +15.2% (SPY +4.8%); risk-off 6 days +0.4% (SPY +0.3%).
News: 17 positions opened on news made +$7,224, the other 41 +$7,270; 11 positions closed on news made +$4,313; over the five days from the fill, news-triggered buys beat SPY by 2.14% (t 1.9).

Concentration: the profit is spread out; the best two positions made 22% of the positions' net P&L, the best being MRK bought 2026-05-29 and still open at the end, +$1,662. Had the best position made nothing, the run would have returned +14.5% instead of +16.1%.
